### 2026-10-06 — # The Beginning

**2h**

# The Beginning

Ok, so... This is my first-ever hardware project, and I have absolutely ZERO prior experience in this.
I made my idea reel earlier today, and right after that, I got into reading the beginner's guide.

The guide is easy to understand, except for a few times where it lacks context.

Like, I had to download KiCad, but I didn't know I had to download the default extensions manually (at least on Arch), and that took a little back-and-forth to get working. Soon, I got a basic schematic going.

![Screenshot_20261006_224704](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Q3cmu2X62iPUkBZEUv2xfbagx5R8vu77/03ee372f5e4806af52e48b98bfa9e77f871a8e8476f96559c5619bae4179663f.png)

And then, while designing, I didn't know you had to actually connect the labels to the pins with a wire (which I missed, as you can see in the last image), and I also didn't know how to use the interface, etc.

But there was nothing a quick Google search couldn't fix; I soon got things working and made my schematic.c

![Screenshot_20261006_233154](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Q3cmu2X62iPUkBZEUv2xfbagx5R8vu77/53ba11bc8d548bca806b84cce0d5b825d4cc51c904841bc1a817f383b40a2e68.png)
